plain_text:
The experience of responding to COVID-19
in both Kisumu and Siaya Counties has
shown that creating the demand and
providing a mix of vaccine delivery
mechanisms to reach key priority groups,
is an effective way to improve vaccine
uptake and achieve greater equity in
coverage. It also shows how choice of
location is key.
